title: cross-zone-kms-keywrap-and-cert-reconciler-operator
author: Asha Patel
description: Background: Private deployments that span multiple availability zones often require KMS master key rotations to be coordinated across regions and siloed HSMs. When the KMS wrapping key rotates, node TLS certificates and sealed secrets that rely on key derivation can become temporarily unverifiable, causing short outages during rolling upgrades. This PR introduces an operator and supporting infra changes to orchestrate safe KMS keywrap rotations and to reconcile TLS/certificate material automatically with a staged rollout and safe rollback path. Motivation: Reduce manual steps for KMS/HSM key rotation and eliminate a class of rotation-induced outages during private upgrades. Automate cross-zone keywrap policy updates, provide a cert-reconciler controller that can re-issue node certificates using the new wrapping key, and add Terraform/Helm primitives so operators can opt into staged rotations. What this changes (summary): - Operator: new "cert-reconciler" Kubernetes controller (controller/ directory) that listens for KMS wrapping key change events (via a CRD) and performs controlled certificate re-issuance for deployments and node agents with support for canary batches and rollback markers. - Helm: adds values.kms.wrapPolicy, values.reconciler.canaryBatches, and an optional preflightJob template to redwood-private-installer chart. - Terraform: new module variable kms_key_rotation_strategy and IAM document helper that creates cross-account alias policies for multi-zone HSM setups. - Vault/SealedSecrets: reconciler integrates with Vault transit and sealed-secrets decryption paths; includes fallbacks when Vault is in read-only mode. - Upgrade tooling: add a dry-run mode and a "staged-rollback" annotation that the reconciler honors to revert certificates to the previous key if health checks fail. Checklist (all items addressed in commits): - [x] CRD and controller implementation with unit tests. - [x] Helm chart templates and example values for both single-zone and cross-zone setups. - [x] Terraform module and example invoking IAM policy adjustments. - [x] Integration tests (local kind cluster + mocked Vault/KMS) demonstrating canary flow. - [x] Docs: UPGRADE_ROTATION.md describing operator workflow and rollback steps. - [x] Security review: minimal ephemeral privileges, KMS usage audited. Backwards compatibility and breaking changes: - Non-breaking by default: operator is opt-in via Helm values.reconciler.enabled=false. - If operators enable the canary/auto-reconcile option, they must ensure Terraform has created the cross-zone KMS alias; failure to do so will be surfaced but can cause certificate reconciliation to pause. - Release note: "Optional cert-reconciler operator to automate KMS keywrap rotation and TLS cert re-issuance. Opt-in via Helm values.reconciler.enabled." Testing performed: - Unit tests for controller reconciliation logic, policy rendering, and rollback marker paths. - Integration tests: simulated KMS rotation in kind cluster with mocked transit/Vault showed zero downtime when canaryBatches=2 and batchSize=10. - Manual verification on an internal staging cluster across 3 AZs. Commits (high-level): - feat(controller): add cert-reconciler controller, CRD, controller runtime scaffolding - feat(helm): add reconciler values and preflightJob template - feat(terraform): add kms rotation strategy variable and iam helper module - docs: add UPGRADE_ROTATION.md and example terraform/helm snippets - test: integration test harness for mock-vault + kind runs Changed files (high level): - controller/, charts/redwood-private-installer/templates/reconciler-*.yaml, charts/redwood-private-installer/values.schema.yaml, terraform/modules/kms/rotation.tf, docs/UPGRADE_ROTATION.md, tests/integration/reconciler-integration.sh, pkg/kms/alias_helper.go, pkg/reconciler/cert_reconciler.go, api/v1alpha1/certreconcile_crd.yaml Review summary and conversation (condensed into notable comments): - Daniel Kim (reviewer): "Can you add explicit safety fences around Vault read-only states? I don't want the operator to auto-issue if Vault cannot sign." — Author: "added a VaultHealth check and preflightJob that rejects auto-reconcile when Vault reports standby/read-only; documented behavior in UPGRADE_ROTATION.md." - Marisol Vega: "The Terraform IAM doc helper needs clear least-privilege boundaries for cross-account aliasing." — Author: "refined IAM document and added testcases that assert only Alias and kms:CreateGrant are permitted for the rotation helper role." - Ethan Zhou: "We should be explicit about cert TTLs when re-issuing to prevent mass expiration." — Author: "controller now preserves originally requested TTL when possible and falls back to a safe default; added unit tests." - CI: initial run failed on linter (helm template lint); fixed template indentation and re-ran; final CI status: pass. Merge notes: squashed and merged after approvals from Daniel and Marisol. Manual post-merge actions: - Terraform: operators must apply terraform/modules/kms with kms_key_rotation_strategy set before enabling reconciler in Helm. - Run preflightJob (helm template and kubectl apply) to validate Vault health across AZs. Related tickets and follow-ups: - ENG-5369: add telemetry for reconciliation progress metrics (follow-up PR) - ENG-5410: extend reconciler to support on-prem HSM plugin for PKCS#11 kcv lookups (future work) How to validate in staging (short): 1) Deploy helm chart with values.reconciler.enabled=true and values.reconciler.dryRun=true; verify preflightJob succeeds. 2) Toggle mocked KMS key alias to new key id in terraform outputs and create a certreconcile CR with canaryBatches=2. 3) Watch cert-reconciler logs; verify only first canary batch certificates are reissued and probes pass before continuing. 4) Flip reconciler.dryRun=false to run a real rotation. 5) If health checks fail, the reconciler will annotate resources with reconciler.redwood.io/rollback-requested and re-apply previous certificate using the previousKeyRef. Additional notes: - This PR intentionally avoids automatic teardown of old key aliases; that is left to operators after a successful rotation window. - Security: all controller pods run with minimal RBAC and ambient capabilities. - Chart bump: charts/redwood-private-installer/Chart.yaml v2.8.0 -> v2.9.0.
